name: Scheduled Recommendations
author: Thunderhat
description: Taste-based film picks from your Letterboxd history, published into Plex or emailed to you on a schedule.

settingsSchema.label: TMDb API key
settingsSchema.help: Used to match films, read age certificates, and check streaming availability. Recommendations still run from your Plex library if this is blank.

settingsSchema.label: Streaming region
settingsSchema.help: ISO country code for streaming availability, for example GB or US.

settingsSchema.label: Your streaming services
settingsSchema.help: Only suggest streaming films on services you have. Schedules that include streaming titles are emailed, because those films are not in your Plex library.

settingsSchema.label: Send recommendation emails to
settingsSchema.help: Leave blank to use the default recipient on the Mail page.

settingsSchema.label: Letterboxd username
settingsSchema.help: Public username. Used to build the activity RSS feed.

settingsSchema.label: Letterboxd RSS URL
settingsSchema.help: Optional. Leave blank to use https://letterboxd.com/{username}/rss/
